mysteryDownload: The Mystery Download.|Part of Wonder Quest Series.

Toby, Finn and Milo were playing at the Woodland Detective Club.|Toby was designing a shiny detective badge on the computer.|Finn was choosing its colours.|Milo was adding three tiny stars.|It looks brilliant! said Toby.
Suddenly, a colourful box flashed on the screen.|Download your free detective game!|Click now!|Toby’s eyes grew wide.|A free detective game! he cried.|Let’s download it!
Wait! said Finn.|We don’t know where it came from.|Milo looked closely at the message.|It doesn’t say who made the game, he noticed.|And some of the words are spelled strangely.

The three friends searched for more clues.|Toby spotted a flashing button.|Finn noticed that the message said:|Hurry! Download now!|Milo found a tiny warning sign beside the file.|This download feels mysterious, he said.

We should use our detective rule, said Finn.|Toby moved his paw away from the button.|The friends went out into the garden to think about it.|There, they reminded each other:|Stop. Don’t click!|Think. Is this download safe?|Ask. Check with a trusted grown-up!

The friends asked Mrs. Hazel to come and help them.|We found a free game, Toby explained.|But we didn’t download it, added Finn.|We thought it might not be safe, said Milo.|Mrs. Hazel smiled.|That was a clever choice.

Mrs. Hazel examined the message.|This is not from a trusted website, she explained.|Some mystery downloads can cause problems.|They may damage a device or try to take private information.|Toby gasped.|I’m glad we didn’t click!

Mrs. Hazel closed the strange message.|Then she showed them the Woodland Club’s approved games page.|If you want to download something, she said, always ask a trusted grown-up to check it first.|Finn nodded.|A colourful button does not mean a download is safe.

Mrs. Hazel helped them choose a safe detective puzzle.|Soon, Toby was following footprints.|Finn was matching secret symbols.|Milo was searching for tiny hidden clues.|This game is fun, laughed Toby.|And we know it is safe! said Finn.

Milo placed a red cross over the mystery download on their clue board.|Toby drew a green tick beside the trusted games page.|Finn wrote:|Check before you download!|We solved the Mystery Download! they cheered.

Before downloading a game, picture or file:|Stop. Do not tap the download button.|Think. Do you know and trust where it came from?|Ask. Let a trusted grown-up check it first.|Toby, Finn and Milo raised their detective paws.
Lesson of the story is [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Stop. Think. Ask.|Before you download!
